verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API covers Spend & Expense, including managing transactions and reimbursements, and offers S&E webhook events. An agent could plausibly read and update transaction data through it. The only MCP server documented serves API documentation to code editors, not live expense data, and nothing shows how an agent would filter for uncoded transactions or write categories back. Missing for 10: documented filtering for uncoded transactions, an API for writing categories/GL coding back, a review/approval queue for agent-proposed coding, any way for an agent to raise policy flags, a data-access MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
